The '''Maad system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was located in the [[Transitory Mists]] region of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] and was surrounded by [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity wells]], [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] debris, and other navigational perils. It had also once contained an unstable triple-world [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] cluster which eventually became a field of icy monoliths. Due to the high number of hazards, any approach into or departure out of the system required lengthy travel through [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]].<ref name="Invincible" />

==History==
The system was inhabited for some time when [[Shedu Maad]] was established as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world. During this period, [[Uroro Station]] was built between the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Qogo]] and [[Uluq]] to serve as a transfer station for [[Hapan]] ships traveling along [[the Throat]] to Shedu Maad. However, mining resources eventually vanished<ref name="TCSWE2">{{CSWECite|III|283|Uroro Station}}</ref> and Shedu Maad was finally abandoned. It was in this system that the [[Jedi Coalition]] established a secret base during their fight against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]. It was here that the Coalition [[Battle of Uroro Station|defeated]] Darth Caedus and ended the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Invincible" />
